read.thesis: BorgWarner guides 2026 organic sales down 1.5%-3.5% and adjusted EPS $5.00-$5.20, with capex rising to 4.5% of sales for the turbine generator launch and a battery sales drag of 150bp.

capex.quote: Capital expenditures guided to 4.5% of sales in 2026, reflecting investments in announced product wins and the new turbine generator system.

guidance.quote: We are projecting total 2026 sales in the range of $14 to $14.3 billion
we expect our 2026 organic sales change to be down 3.5% to down 1.5% year over year
We expect our full-year adjusted operating margin to be in the range of 10.7% to 10.9%
we're expecting full-year adjusted EPS in the range of $5 to $5.2 per diluted share
We expect full-year free cash flow to be in the range of $900 million to $1.1 billion
you could see our CapEx guide is four and a half percent of sales
